curation.why: JSON has no declarations, so the generator proposes nothing: it only promotes kinds it sees wrapping a declaration. The structure a reader navigates by is the key path, and a `pair` is the only kind with a name (its `key` field). Making it a landmark anchors queries on the enclosing keys; labelling it `variable` (the closest shared concept for a named value) and making that a container gives a nested line a breadcrumb trail of the keys above it. `object` and `array` are deliberately left out: they are anonymous values, so they add no name to a breadcrumb and would only add anchors between the keys.
